notable_absence.finding: Pure code-sample page demonstrating the Basic Bucket Accessor SET/GET/DEL syntax (`dst_col[dst_key] = doc_to_wr`, `dst_col[dst_key]`, `delete dst_col[dst_key]`) - byte-identical mechanism to the Capella twin, which left concepts/relations empty for the same reason: no genuinely new mechanism beyond eventing:binding/eventing:bucket-alias-binding, already well-established in the registry. The page's version-comment ladder is worth naming once for the batch: the `Version 6.X` tier configures a whole-bucket 'Source Bucket'/'MetaData Bucket'/plain-bucket binding target, while the `Version 7.0+`/`7.1+` tiers configure a `bucket.scope.collection` binding target and a `Function Scope` - the same pre-7.0-vs-7.0+ scoping split recurs verbatim across nearly every page in this batch and is not re-described on each subsequent record.
